data.summary: sbx-devvv is a generated sandbox environment definition directory for the sandbox manager (design §3.5), holding the Docker build fragment and the Docker Compose topology for a single named sandbox ("devvv"). The two files work together to define how the sandbox image is bootstrapped (Dockerfile.base HEAD fragment) and how it is run at runtime (compose.yml with a Caddy gateway and the sandbox app container on an isolated network). It is infrastructure/configuration scaffolding rather than business logic.

file_insights.name: compose.yml
file_insights.summary: Generated Docker Compose definition for the "devvv" sandbox, declaring a Caddy gateway service that fronts the sandbox app service and wires them onto an internal sandbox network plus the aio manager network.
file_insights.source_summary: YAML defining two services: `gateway` (caddy:2, restart unless-stopped, mounts ./gateway/Caddyfile read-only, networks sandbox-net and aio-mgr-net with alias sbx-devvv, depends_on app) and `app` (image sandbox-app-df882efe5ef5, restart unless-stopped, environment variables for phase-2 app-side wiring).
file_insights.detailed_description: This compose file is emitted by sandbox-mgr for sandbox "devvv" and is intended to be hand-operable via `docker compose -p sbx-devvv -f <file> <cmd>`. It defines the runtime topology: a `gateway` container using the caddy:2 image with a read-only Caddyfile mount, attached to both the sandbox network and the aio-mgr network under the alias `sbx-devvv`, and an `app` container built from the sandbox-app image. Because it is generated, it is the authoritative runtime contract for this specific sandbox instance.
responsibilities: Declare the sandbox runtime service topology (gateway + app)
Attach the sandbox to sandbox-net and aio-mgr-net with the sbx-devvv alias
Mount the Caddy reverse-proxy configuration read-only into the gateway
Define restart policy and dependency ordering between gateway and app

file_insights.name: Dockerfile.base
file_insights.summary: HEAD fragment of the assembled Dockerfile.base, providing the shared root-context bootstrap (HTTPS apt, CA self-bootstrap, build-essential) that every derived sandbox image inherits.
file_insights.source_summary: A Dockerfile HEAD fragment with `# syntax=docker/dockerfile:1`, comments describing the head + scenario fragments + tail assembly model performed by `aio-config gen`, and the root-context bootstrap steps for apt-over-HTTPS, CA self-bootstrap and build-essential installation.
file_insights.detailed_description: This file is not a complete Dockerfile: `aio-config gen` concatenates this HEAD fragment with enabled scenario fragments and a tail to produce the final Dockerfile.base. It captures the non-versioned root-context bootstrap shared by all derived images, installing HTTPS-capable apt, bootstrapping CA certificates, and build-essential, and it documents that everything (including the runtime default user and the /root workspace owner) runs as root so the shared workspace volume can persist dotfiles.
responsibilities: Provide the shared, non-versioned bootstrap layer for all sandbox images
Configure apt over HTTPS and self-bootstrap CA certificates
Install build-essential and baseline build tooling
Establish root as build and runtime user so /root can host the persistent workspace volume
